name: Thompson Madrid
positioning: Thompson Madrid, by Hyatt: a contemporary hotel beside Plaza del Carmen in central Madrid, with residential-style rooms, a rooftop restaurant and a speakeasy-style piano bar
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to Puerta del Sol, Plaza Mayor and Gran Via
Guests who like design, local art and lively bars under the same roof

facts.text: Thompson Madrid is set beside Plaza del Carmen, moments from Puerta del Sol, Plaza Mayor, Gran Via and Plaza de Espana.
The nearest metro stations are Gran Via and Sol.
Rooms and suites bring together natural wood, leather and marble with residential-inspired contemporary design.
Rooms come with D.S. & Durga bath amenities and a rain shower.
Rooms have a minifridge stocked with locally sourced products.
Select rooms and suites have private terraces.
The Penthouse occupies the top floor and has a private balcony overlooking landmarks including Puerta del Sol and the Royal Palace.
La Barra de Ultramarines is a traditional Spanish bar in the hotel where tapas are made for sharing.
In-room dining is available 24 hours a day.
The hotel has a 24-hour fitness center.
The hotel welcomes both dogs and cats.
The hotel's carpeting pays homage to Madrid's cobblestoned streets.

highlights.text: Jack's Club is an intimate piano bar inspired by classic speakeasies and the charm of a private library, with live jazz and signature cocktails.
The building, designed by the firm Lopez y Tena, is defined by two large central courtyards that let light in.
Thompson Terrace Suite and Penthouse guests can borrow handcrafted capes by Spanish fashion house OTEYZA.
Makaa is the rooftop restaurant, bringing together Mediterranean cuisine, open-fire cooking and panoramic city views.
Works by local artists hang throughout the hotel, with a different floor dedicated to each artist.

considerations.text: The hotel is inside Madrid Central, the city's low-emission zone, so local traffic rules apply if you arrive by car.
WhataHotel notes the urban location can bring street noise.
